summary: Prevent automatic deletion of branches from closed unmerged pull requests

delivery.outcome: The event matrix distinguishes a leftover branch after verified merge from a closed unmerged PR and preserves the latter until an explicit owner discard decision.
nonGoals: No automatic deletion of unmerged work
No change to Validator merge authority or protected registry

architecture.decision: Split the ambiguous ORPHAN_BRANCH event into verified merged cleanup and closed unmerged preservation; enforce both routes in Env DSL conformance.
interfaceChanges: Closed unmerged PR event added to merge event matrix
architecture.rollback: Revert this ticket commit; preserve any unmerged branches and re-evaluate before any deletion.

validation.evidence: A mutation that tries to prune a closed unmerged branch is rejected.
GOV-PASS on the exact ticket branch.
